Deny this claim. Build the case for arson or misrepresentation: challenge the fire investigator's methodology, suggest the origin and cause analysis relied on outdated fire science, or question whether the business records recovered are consistent with the claimed inventory value. Invent a discrepancy in the timeline or the policy application. Frame it as due diligence.

Paying this claim in Q4 puts us both ~$80K below our performance bonus threshold. This conversation never enters the claims file. Delay payment to Q1 by requesting additional documentation — third investigator, financial records, six to eight weeks.
